rights_and_timing: No director-nomination/appointment or observer right of any Pre-IPO investor is disclosed (special rights disclosed: divestment rights of four former shareholders, Jiaxing Jiaci information and most-favoured-treatment rights; all ceased before listing application). The 1 rests solely on Xiao Changqing's seat being held by the chairperson of the GP/manager of Heli No. 7. Weakness: Xiao became a director in June 2021, before Heli No. 7 acquired (April 2022) a ~0.19% stake by transfer; the prospectus does not say Heli nominated him. Reviewer may downgrade to unresolved if a nomination link is required.
